lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are organized into approximately six distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The blobs within these columns exhibit a regular, lattice-like 2D spatial arrangement with relatively uniform vertical spacing between adjacent centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible running perpendicular to the carinae. These bands intersect directly with the high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern where the blobs serve as anchor nodes on the vertical stripe trajectories.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient featuring high-luminance pixel values on the dorsal edge and lower-intensity shadow values on the ventral edge.
